title: Chapter 1427
text:
An intense battle broke out between the two of them.

Dozens of doppelgangers with different Esper Abilities cooperated flawlessly. As soon as they exchanged blows, EsGod suppressed the Subduing Tree King. The combination of various Esper Abilities and combo attacks dazzled everyone. The exquisite and complicated operations immediately made the Subduing Tree King dizzy.

Previously, when EsGod had just summoned his doppelgangers, the attention of all the Beyond Grade As on both sides was attracted. Now that they saw the Subduing Tree King in such a sorry state, they could not help but have strange expressions.

"What a strong Esper. With so many Beyond Grade A doppelgangers assisting in the battle, although the Subduing Tree King has the advantage in terms of explosive power, all his actions are interrupted by the large group of doppelgangers. He can't seize the rhythm of the battle at all and is completely passive …"

Fortitude Tree King wrestled with Herberlon while observing the battle on the Subduing Tree King's side. The more he watched, the more afraid he became.

The Subduing Tree King was held back by a large group of EsGod doppelgangers and could not control the situation. He was like a weak teenager forced into an alley by a group of strong men. He could not control himself and was getting more and more separated from the main force.

This strong enemy did not have the terrifying strength of Black Star, but Fortitude Tree King felt that it was also troublesome. When a Super with a single ability faced such an opponent, if the strength of both sides did not have an insurmountable gap, then they would be at a disadvantage. A Pugilist who only knew how to beat people was an example.

Luckily, I'm a Mechanic …

This thought appeared in Fortitude Tree King's mind.

On the other side, the Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations looked at EsGod with surprise in their eyes.

"EsGod without any restraints is really terrifying. His true combat strength is actually so strong …"

Many people were shocked.

Most people knew of EsGod's name, and many people had fought him personally. However, EsGod's current combat strength was much stronger than what they remembered. He was not this strong in the past.

"It seems like the Underworld suits him very well."

Manison's eyes flickered, and his tone was complicated.

EsGod had been imprisoned for nearly a hundred years and had wasted so many years. However, as soon as he entered the Underworld, he was like a fish in water. His stubborn illness was gone, and his combat strength increased explosively. He had been studying hard for so many years, but due to Black Star's persistent targeting, his combat strength had actually regressed. He realized that he had no confidence in dealing with the current EsGod. It was even worse than before.

With such a comparison, Manison felt sad for himself.

Seeing the battle between the two of them, everyone was shocked and quickly took action. The World Tree experts tried to help, but the morale of the three Universal Civilizations was greatly boosted. They tried even harder to stop the enemy, not allowing the enemy experts to leave the team battle to help.

For the time being, the two of them couldn't care less about their teammates' movements. They were fully focused on the battle and dealing with their opponents.

…

The green meteor rampaged through the battlefield, but it was like a small bug that had fallen into a spider web. All of its attacks were neutralized by the strange defensive Esper Abilities of the EsGod doppelgangers. The Subduing Tree King could not break out of EsGod's encirclement at all and could only be dragged along.

The Subduing Tree King launched another melee combo attack, but the heavy fist that was shining with green light easily pierced through EsGod's body. It did not hit anything, as if it had passed through an illusion.

Before he could do anything else, an EsGod doppelganger suddenly appeared from the side and floated over like smoke. It turned into the power of the curse and attached itself to his body. He suddenly felt his entire body go limp, and he could not even use half of his strength.

The Subduing Tree King did not have the time to clear the negative status, and the dozen or so EsGod doppelgangers around him released different types of energy attacks at the same time.

Some shot out high-energy lasers from their eyes, some shot out silver X-shaped rays from their hands, some shot out lightning chains from their electromagnetic fields like mahjong, and some pushed out dark red energy waves from their hands. There were all kinds of strange attacks.

Bang! Bang!

Bang! Colorful energy struck the Subduing Tree King's body, and the light in the field expanded before exploding, causing the Subduing Tree King to roll backward.

Before he could fly far, the Subduing Tree King felt something tighten around his waist. It turned out that an EsGod doppelganger was already waiting on the way and hugging him.

He reacted quickly and gave a powerful elbow strike to the head of the EsGod doppelganger. However, he did not manage to push the other party back. The head of the EsGod doppelganger suddenly became blurry, as if it was vibrating at a high frequency, and all the kinetic energy was absorbed.

The next moment, the EsGod doppelganger's crotch pushed forward, and the kinetic energy rebounded. It did not miss anything and rushed into the Subduing Tree King's body, causing him to feel intense pain all over his body.

"Get lost!"

The Subduing Tree King's expression was twisted, and his aura erupted. He broke free from the control and threw the EsGod doppelganger away.

However, before he could take any further action, more than ten mental attacks from different Esper Abilities suddenly exploded in his brain. The Subduing Tree King immediately spat out blood from his mouth and nose, and his soul was injured. A lot of negative statuses appeared on his mind, and he felt dizzy.

He endured bitterly and was about to use the World Tree Roots to save himself when he realized that the World Tree Roots had already been controlled by another batch of EsGod doppelganger's space, force field, and other Esper Abilities. It was as if they had fallen into a swamp and could not move.

"How many Esper Abilities do you have?"

The Subduing Tree King was completely shocked.

After fighting for a while, this opponent had already used more than a hundred Esper Abilities. Attack, defense, control, evasion … All kinds of domains were like a bottomless abyss. There was simply no limit to it!

Up until now, EsGod had never used any big moves to cause him heavy injuries. However, this kind of fighting style was like eating away at his life bit by bit, constantly causing light injuries, causing his injuries to accumulate time and time again. It was extremely disgusting.

"I didn't count."

EsGod's tone was calm as he continued to attack.

His Esper Abilities were endless, and he could be said to be omnipotent. He completely controlled the rhythm of the battle and did not give the Subduing Tree King a chance to catch his breath. His lethality was secondary, and the strongest was his near-perfect control chain.

The Subduing Tree King endured the dense attacks as he observed the situation with difficulty. Seeing that the main force was getting further and further away, he could not help but feel a chill in his heart.

"My teammates are being held back, and it's very difficult for them to rush over to support me. If I continue fighting with him like this, my condition will continue to decline, and the chances of escaping will become slimmer and slimmer …"

The Subduing Tree King's expression changed, and he suddenly had an idea.

That's right, Black Star hasn't appeared yet. How can he not participate in the battle? He must be secretly waiting for me!

The Heart Tree King has fallen, and Black Star definitely knows that the other Tree Kings will be even more vigilant, so he hid for the time being and pretended not to participate in the battle. He wanted to use this to lower my guard. When this Esper exhausts my condition to a certain extent, he will suddenly attack and seal me!

At this moment, the Subduing Tree King felt that his thoughts had cleared up.

That must be it. This is a trap!

"That was close. If I wasn't decisive enough, I would have fallen for it today … I definitely can't fall for his trick!"

He thought that he had understood Black Star's plan and made up his mind.

EsGod did not know anything about the Subduing Tree King's thoughts. Just as he was about to order his doppelganger to launch a new wave of attacks, a terrifying energy was suddenly released from the Subduing Tree King's body.

"Hmm? This feeling is … "

EsGod's pupils constricted, and he retreated without hesitation.

The Subduing Tree King's face was filled with determination, and his body suddenly emitted a strong light.

"I'd rather self-destruct than let you succeed!"

Bang!

His entire body exploded, and an intense energy shockwave spread out. The EsGod doppelgangers around him were all sent flying, and the World Tree Roots also turned into light and disappeared inch by inch.

The Subduing Tree King had always thought that he was a rational Pugilist. His current choice was based on his own interests.

He was being held back by EsGod, and Black Star was eyeing him from the dark. The chances of him escaping were slim, so he decided to self-destruct before his condition deteriorated to the point where he could not retaliate.

On one hand, he wanted the enemy's sneak attack to fail, and on the other hand, he wanted his teammates to stop coming to support him.

He had killed two birds with one stone!

There was only one word to describe it — wonderful!

Swoosh!

EsGod's figure flashed, and he avoided the shockwave of the self-destruction with a surprised expression.

It was not easy for him to find an opponent, and he wanted to have a good fight. He did not expect the enemy to explode just like that.

In his opinion, although the Subduing Tree King was at a disadvantage, he was still a Tree King. Even if he had the advantage, it would be extremely difficult for him to kill the other party. The current situation was far from the time to self-destruct …

"Forget it, at least the target has been dealt with."

EsGod suddenly shook his head and laughed.

The situation of the battle changed rapidly. If the Subduing Tree King resisted to the end, he might still have a chance to escape. However, for some reason, he actually self-destructed now. Then, there was no need to worry about any accidents.

Black Star's instructions were to kill this guy. If his opponent killed himself, it would save him some effort.

On the other side, the Fortitude Tree King was shocked when he sensed the Subduing Tree King's self-destruction.

He felt that although the situation was not good, it was not impossible. Why did he give up hope of survival just like that? He could still be saved …

The Fortitude Tree King quickly received the mental activity of the Subduing Tree King before he died and immediately understood.

"So he did this because he was worried about falling into the enemy's trap …"

The Fortitude Tree King was speechless.

Because of the revival mechanism, to the World Tree experts, this method of self-destruction to prevent being captured by the enemy was very common. The last time, the Subduing Tree King had self-destructed and died like this. He did not expect it to be the same this time. It was surprisingly similar …

The Fortitude Tree King did not know if he should say that the Subduing Tree King was decisive or that the Subduing Tree King had died in the same place twice.

In just one test, he had lost a Tree King. He only felt tired.

"Sigh, it can't be said to be a bad thing. He did die a little too quickly, but I guarantee that he won't suffer like the Heart Tree King."

The Fortitude Tree King sighed in his heart. He could only think on the bright side … At the very least, the Subduing Tree King's sacrifice was not worthless. At the very least, he had found out the opponent's background.

This unfamiliar Esper who was not inferior to Black Star, as well as that large-scale killing device that left no traces behind, must be the enemy's trump card.

With this information, he would be able to prepare in advance the next time they fought … He had finally gained something from this battle. He felt that the Subduing Tree King had died a worthy death.

It was a pity that this tool was gone. He could not slack off anymore.

Thinking of this, the Fortitude Tree King no longer had any intention of fighting. He suppressed the anger in his heart and immediately ordered a retreat.

"Let's go!"

The many World Tree experts no longer fought and retreated as they fought. After paying a price, they finally returned to the main formation and were protected by the fleet again.

Seeing this, the Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations did not chase after them and retreated into the defensive circle.

Seeing this, the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations, who were watching the battle remotely, relaxed and were secretly surprised.

Without Black Star making a move, a portion of the Beyond Grade As had given the World Tree experts a head-on blow, causing the enemy to suffer. In their eyes, this was undoubtedly the result of Black Star's training over the past ten years.

"Although Black Star is unpredictable, he is still trustworthy in this aspect."

"There shouldn't be anyone in the entire galactic society who knows how to nurture Supers better than him. Black Star has contributed a lot to this huge improvement. His ten years of hard work have allowed us to gain the advantage in terms of individual strength."

The three of them were more or less relieved.

…

At the same time.

In the base, Han Xiao raised his brows when he saw the Subduing Tree King explode into the most beautiful fireworks.

"He actually chose to self-destruct at this time … Could it be that he's afraid that I'll ambush him? Ha, isn't this a case of being too smart for your own good? Among Pugilists, you're one of the more simple-minded ones. "

Han Xiao could not help but laugh.

He did not intend to make a move, but he did not expect the Subduing Tree King to scare himself and decisively die … It could only be said that he had left quite a shadow in the World Tree's heart.

This time, without his help, the other teammates had already made the World Tree suffer a loss. There was no doubt that their improvement was significant, and Hella and the others could take charge alone. He was very satisfied.

Most importantly, a portion of the revivors and newborns suppressed their impulses until the end of the battle and did not appear to participate in the battle. This meant that the revival of the Holy Covenant was still not exposed. To Han Xiao, this was a great thing.

The World Tree's attack was clearly just a probe, and they had only revealed the tip of the iceberg. They had not revealed all of their trump cards and killed the Subduing Tree King while keeping a portion of their trump cards. Sending this b * stard home to hibernate was more worth it than expected!

As a result, the World Tree did not obtain more information and still maintained the wrong judgment that the exchange strategy was effective.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he stroked his chin with a playful smile.

"It seems like you guys don't even have the right to enjoy the gift I've prepared for you … Alright, I'll give you this surprise when you send out a Tree King with enough strength."
